title: Zi-Thuuli of the Granite Claw
summary: Drive Zi-Thuuli away through three encounters before the final confrontation.
overview: Drive Zi-Thuuli away through three encounters before the final confrontation.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Engage promptly when Zi-Thuuli appears; an idle appearance ends after fifteen seconds.
His first three encounters end at 55%, 50% and 45% health respectively.
Prepare for the recurring stone spell during longer engagements.
The next appearance after the third retreat is the killable finale.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 1.
The script marks the ninety-second stone interval as an estimate. Full database spell behavior remains unverified.
